title: Hüg 2022 · Guided reaching and auditory PPS
citation: Hüg, M. X., Bermejo, F., Tommasini, F. C., & Di Paolo, E. A. (2022). Effects of guided exploration on reaching measures of auditory peripersonal space. Frontiers in Psychology, 13, 983189.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.static_source: Reposition a physical Sony SRS-X11 on a narrow table while lateral sources mask setup noise. Calibrate 65 dBA at the head with the source at 100 cm, keeping source gain fixed across locations.
published_method.cue: Three stationary 100 ms broadband Gaussian noise bursts with 2 ms half-Hamming edges. The 50 ms gaps produce a 400 ms sequence.
published_method.schedule: 92 pretest, 92 training and 92 posttest trials, preceded by four familiarization trials. Measure arm-only and arm-plus-trunk maximum reach first.
published_method.response: At cue offset, point by reaching to the perceived location and rest the hand on the table, or report 'too far' without moving. Track location at the hand with Polhemus Patriot.
published_method.training: No-feedback participants repeat the assessment. Active participants search for physical speaker contact. Guided participants are moved with a sling to contact the source if reachable.
published_method.analysis: Compute reachability, normalized perceived distance, perceived maximum reach and direction-specific or absolute distance error. The Zenodo observations support nine reused assessment orders but do not determine the original generation or training order.

stimulus_type.value: Stationary Gaussian broadband noise in three bursts

value.kind: Three stationary bursts of Gaussian broadband noise
value.ramp_type: Half-Hamming rise and fall per burst
value.speaker: Sony SRS-X11 cube, 6.1 cm each side
value.gain: Fixed source gain across distances. Ear-level SPL at other locations not reported.
value.masking: Separate lateral speakers masked repositioning before each trial. Spectrum, gain, timing and device models unreported.

value.room_measurement: REW deconvolution with apparatus mounted and room unoccupied

value.reachable: After stimulus, move hand to perceived position and rest it on table. Speaker removed immediately after sound in assessment, eliminating contact feedback.
value.unreachable: Say too far and stay still.

value.timing_caveat: Exact deadline, ITI and source-reposition delay unreported. Sound offset is the response cue.

implementation_gaps: Recreate a calibrated physically repositioned loudspeaker, room acoustics, masking and tracking. Earphone distance proxies would change the task.
Implement reachability calibration, reaching and verbal response capture and feedback delivery across the three training groups.
Recover the original audio samples, masking details, setup/ITI timing and participant order generation.
